title: ExpectedFailure v1
description: Declares the validator failure a synthetic negative fixture must produce. Unknown optional properties are tolerated so the contract can evolve within major version 1.

tooling_schema_version.description: Semantic version of this tooling contract, independent of the observation schemas.

command.description: Validator subcommand that must be run to reproduce the failure.

expected_error_code.description: Error code from contracts/tooling/validator_error_codes.v1.json that the command must emit.

artifact_path.description: Repository-relative path of the artifact the failure must be reported against.

description.description: Human-readable summary of the declared negative case.
